summary_rationale: TANFAC has a long-running integrated fluorine-chemistry platform, high FY26 utilization in core acids, completed HF and solar-grade DHF expansions, contracted demand visibility and a stronger post-raise equity base. Those strengths are offset by commodity and end-market cyclicality, a past downturn described in retrospective reporting, FY26 and H1 FY27 margin moderation, operating cash flow below PAT during capacity build-out, working-capital sensitivity, and execution, qualification and regulatory uncertainty around HFC-32 and newer products. The supplied evidence supports conditional operating quality with close attention to ramp, cash conversion, spread stability and project delivery; the secondary 2015–2026 history adds cycle context but remains rounded and requires primary-source reconciliation; product-level profitability is still undisclosed.
